title: Avatar: Seven Havens
syn: With Ellora under lockdown, Pavi steals away to the Eastern Outskirts and finally discovers her old home. Meanwhile, out in the Harshlands, Nisha makes a new spirit friend who leads her to unlock a memory she wishes she could forget.

title: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
syn: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty is the first entry in Star Wars: Smugglers and Scoundrels, a line of canon graphic novels published by Mad Cave Studios. Originally announced for a September 13, 2026 release before being delayed to October 6 , it is written by Cavan Scott and illustrated by Christian Colbert, and will be released on November 17, 2026.
wiki: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
syn_fr: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty est une bande dessinée one-shot écrite par Cavan Scott.

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 4
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 4 is the upcoming fourth issue of the 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on November 18, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 4 est le quatrième numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: Blade Runner 2099
syn: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.
syn_fr: Dans le Los Angeles de 2099, Cora a vécu toute sa vie en cavale, un caméléon forcé d'adopter de nombreuses identités. Pour assurer un avenir stable à son frère, elle prend une dernière identité et est contrainte de s'associer à Olwen, une Blade Runner confrontée à la fin de sa vie. Les deux sont entraînés dans une conspiration grandissante qui représente une menace existentielle pour une ville qui lutte pour renaître.

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 5
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 5 is the upcoming fifth and final issue of the 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on December 2, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 5 est le cinquième et dernier numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: Andrzej Sapkowski's The Witcher: The Last Wish–The Complete Collection
syn: Andrzej Sapkowski's The Witcher: The Last Wish–The Complete Collection is a book published by Dark Horse Comics that features the comic adaptations of the short stories from and one never before published adaptation of The Voice of Reason. It will be released on December 15, 2026.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
syn: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
syn_fr: Les Avengers, les Wakandais, les Quatre Fantastiques, les New Avengers et les X-Men, tous héros issus de trois univers distincts se retrouvent sur une trajectoire de collision mortelle et font face à une menace existentielle sans précédent, comme ils n'en ont jamais rencontré auparavant, le Docteur Doom.

title: Ahsoka — Escape from Thrawn 1
syn: Ahsoka — Escape from Thrawn 1 is the first issue of the five-issue miniseries Star Wars: Ahsoka — Escape from Thrawn, which will tell the story of Ezra Bridger's escape from the Chimaera during the events of the finale of the first season of the television series Star Wars: Ahsoka. It will be written by Rodney Barnes using a story by Dave Filoni, drawn by Andrea Di Vito, and will be published by M…

title: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
syn: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon is the first entry in Star Wars: Tales from the Outer Rim, a line of canon graphic novels published by Mad Cave Studios. Written by Greg Pak and illustrated by Brent Schoonover, it will be released on March 9, 2027.
wiki: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
syn_fr: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon est une bande dessinée one-shot écrite par Greg Pak.

title: Twin Crossroads
syn: Twin Crossroads is an upcoming canon adult novel that takes place between the events of Episode VI: Return of the Jedi and Episode VII: The Force Awakens, and will be written by Beth Revis and published in hardcover by Random House Worlds on April 6, 2027. It was first listed on the Penguin Random House website on July 18, 2026 and was officially announced at the Random House Worlds panel at San D…
syn_fr: Twin Crossroads est un roman écrit par Beth Revis. Il sera publié le 6 avril 2027 par Random House Worlds aux États-Unis.

title: Princess of the Rebellion
syn: Princess of the Rebellion is a forthcoming young adult novel focusing on Princess Leia that takes place between the events of Episode IV: A New Hope and Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back, and will be published by Random House/Star Wars on May 4, 2027, as part of the 50th anniversary of A New Hope. Written by Claudia Gray, the book will focus on Leia in the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin as the …
syn_fr: Princess of the Rebellion est un roman jeunes adultes écrit par Claudia Gray. Il sera publié le 4 mai 2027 par Disney–Lucasfilm Press aux États-Unis. Il sera adapté en livre audio aux États-Unis.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
syn: When a cynical rogue is confronted by his mysterious past, he is hurled into a dangerous adventure across the galaxy that puts him on a crash course with destiny.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
syn: Hunted by Miguel O'Hara's Spider Society and betrayed by his friends, Miles finds himself in the darkest corners of the Spider-Verse in search of a way home. Knowing that his family has been not only fractured but endangered by his calling, it's a race against the clock for Miles to travel across the wildest reaches of time and space to fight for and reunite everything he holds most dear.

title: Man of Tomorrow
syn: Superman and Lex Luthor find themselves forced to work together—to a certain degree—against a much, much bigger threat when Brainiac sets his sights on Earth.

title: Reign of the Empire: From the Ashes
syn: Reign of the Empire: From the Ashes is an upcoming novel and the final entry in the Star Wars: Reign of the Empire trilogy written by Fran Wilde and set to be published by Random House Worlds on August 10, 2027.
wiki: Reign of the Empire: From the Ashes
syn_fr: Reign of the Empire: From the Ashes est un roman écrit par Fran Wilde. Il est le troisième roman de la trilogie Star Wars : Le Règne de l'Empire. Il sera publié le 8 juin 2027 par Random House Worlds aux États-Unis.

title: Avengers: Secret Wars
syn: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga.
syn_fr: Adaptation de Secret Wars de Jim Shooter et un prochain film de la phase 6 du Marvel Cinematic Universe qui conclura la saga du multivers.
